revelation.9.p1.b1.text: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.

revelation.9.p1.b2.text: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.

revelation.9.p1.b3.text: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, …

revelation.9.p2.b4.text: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

revelation.9.p2.b5.text: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.

revelation.9.p3.b6.text: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, …

revelation.9.p3.b7.text: … the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

revelation.9.p3.b8.text: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.

revelation.9.p4.b9.text: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.

revelation.9.p4.b10.text: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God

revelation.9.p4.b11.text: “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

revelation.9.p4.b12.text: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

revelation.9.p5.b13.text: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.

revelation.9.p5.b14.text: … The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.

revelation.9.p5.b15.text: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.

revelation.9.p6.b16.text: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.

revelation.9.p6.b17.text: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
